color.$description: Semantic colors: {bg|fg|border}.{role}.{emphasis}[.{state}], aliasing the palette. Every fg.on-X pairs with its bg.X, and every hover and pressed state is its own token, so the contrast gate, the docs and the generated modules see the real values. This file holds the light scheme at standard contrast; color-scheme/dark.tokens.json and contrast/high.tokens.json override it. The flat names after the groups are the 0.7 custom properties, kept as aliases until components move to the semantic names.

$root.$description: The page behind all content: the app frame, title bars and Surface background="page". Deeper than the panes and cards on it in both themes, so they part from it.

hover.$description: An interactive page-colored surface under the pointer.

pressed.$description: An interactive page-colored surface while pressed.

$root.$description: A recessed surface: a well that what it holds rises out of, such as a stage for a preview or a drop area, and Surface background="recessed". A shade deeper than the page in dark; in light a shade lighter than the page and the panes, since a deeper gray would take edges and focus rings below 3:1. Everything measured on the page keeps its minimum on it.

hover.$description: An interactive recessed surface under the pointer.

pressed.$description: An interactive recessed surface while pressed.

$root.$description: The default surface: Surface, navigation, sheets, standard menus. A step lighter than the page in both themes.

hover.$description: An interactive default surface, such as a card or a list row, under the pointer.

pressed.$description: An interactive default surface while pressed. Muted text and an inset focus ring keep their minimums on it.

$root.$description: The muted surface: Surface background="muted", cards, list and radio rows. Lighter than the default surface in both themes, white in light, so cards stand apart from a pane.

hover.$description: An interactive muted surface under the pointer.

pressed.$description: An interactive muted surface while pressed.

$root.$description: A raised surface: Surface background="raised", rows on a contrasting surface, outlined buttons.

hover.$description: An interactive raised surface under the pointer.

pressed.$description: An interactive raised surface while pressed.

$root.$description: Popups over the page: menus, Select lists, popovers, the composer. They take elevation 2. In light a gray between the recessed well and the panes, so a popup parts from the white cards it opens over; in dark a step lighter than the page.

hover.$description: A highlighted row in a popup.

pressed.$description: A pressed row in a popup.

field.$description: A well that keeps a fill of its own, such as the color picker's value button and code and references in rich text. Text fields have none: they take the background of what they sit on.

$root.$description: The backdrop behind dialogs and the command palette: the dark page color at 32% in light, which sets the page back without turning it gray, and black at 50% in dark, where the page color would not darken it.

muted.$description: The lighter backdrop behind a sheet that leaves the page usable, such as a supporting pane over its main pane: the dark page color at 20% in light and black at 30% in dark.

$root.$description: Selected navigation items, tree and table rows, Select options and drop targets; paired with fg.on-selected. A blue tint in light and a blue-gray in dark, distinct from the other items around it, at rest and under the pointer: ΔEOK 0.03 or more, 0.04 at high contrast.

hover.$description: A selected item under the pointer: visibly deeper than the selection, and distinct from an unselected item under the pointer.

pressed.$description: A selected item while pressed. Muted text and an inset focus ring keep their minimums on it.

$root.$description: A navigation item that isn’t selected, at rest: no fill, over the navigation’s own background.

hover.$description: A navigation item that isn’t selected, under the pointer: a blue-gray tint in light, deeper than the selection so it doesn’t read as selected; in dark and at high contrast, a gray, since a blue tint there would read as the selection.

pressed.$description: A navigation item that isn’t selected, while pressed. Its label and an inset focus ring keep their minimums on it, which puts it one grade deeper than the hover in light.

$root.$description: The translucent neutral fill of secondary buttons, chips, switch tracks and skeletons: a layer of the text color, so it keeps its tone on every surface.

hover.$description: The neutral fill under the pointer.

pressed.$description: The neutral fill while pressed.

$root.$description: Controls without a fill at rest, such as quiet buttons, inactive tabs and menubar triggers.

hover.$description: The state layer over a control without a fill, under the pointer.

pressed.$description: The state layer over a control without a fill, while pressed.

emphasis.$description: A solid neutral fill, such as a solid neutral badge; paired with fg.on-emphasis.

$root.$description: The dark neutral fill of tooltips and neutral toasts in both themes; paired with fg.on-strong.

hover.$description: A control on the strong neutral fill under the pointer.

pressed.$description: A control on the strong neutral fill while pressed.

$root.$description: The primary fill of primary actions, chosen radios and the chosen calendar day; paired with fg.on-emphasis. In dark and at high contrast, checked checkboxes, switches that are on, sliders, meters and spinners take it too: a soft blue with dark marks at 4.5:1.

hover.$description: A primary action under the pointer.

pressed.$description: A primary action while pressed.

$root.$description: The saturated primary fill of checked checkboxes, switches that are on, sliders, meters and spinners in the light theme at standard contrast, with white marks, the check and the thumb, at 3:1. The dark theme and high contrast put those controls on the emphasis fill instead; in dark this fill, which keeps 3:1 against the surfaces, would put white text below 4.5:1.

hover.$description: A checked control under the pointer.

pressed.$description: A checked control while pressed.

$root.$description: Controls in the primary tone without a fill at rest, such as an alert’s dismiss button: transparent, as color.bg.neutral.subtle is.

hover.$description: The state layer of a control without a fill in the primary tone, such as an info alert’s dismiss button, under the pointer: the primary text color at 14%, in every theme and at high contrast.

pressed.$description: The primary state layer while pressed: the primary text color at 22%.

muted.$description: The translucent primary tint of info alerts, and of soft primary badges in dark and at high contrast; in light they take color.bg.primary.soft. An application may put a container in it, with links in fg.link-on-muted.

soft.$description: The tint of a soft primary badge. In light it is the primary blue at 5%, fainter than color.bg.primary.muted, so the blue text keeps 4.5:1 over it on list rows and muted surfaces; in dark and at high contrast it is color.bg.primary.muted.

solid.$description: A solid primary fill, such as a solid primary badge or a navigation item's count, a grade deeper than the emphasis fill in light; paired with fg.on-emphasis.

emphasis.$description: A solid success fill; paired with fg.on-emphasis.

muted.$description: The translucent success tint of badges and alerts.

$root.$description: Controls in the success tone without a fill at rest, such as an alert’s dismiss button: transparent, as color.bg.neutral.subtle is.

hover.$description: The state layer of a control without a fill in the success tone, such as a success alert’s dismiss button, under the pointer: the success text color at 14%, in every theme and at high contrast.

pressed.$description: The success state layer while pressed: the success text color at 22%.

$root.$description: The teal success fill of toasts in both themes; paired with fg.on-strong.

hover.$description: A control on the success toast, its dismiss button, under the pointer. Its white label keeps 4.5:1.

pressed.$description: A control on the success toast while pressed. Its white label keeps 4.5:1.

emphasis.$description: A solid warning fill; paired with fg.on-emphasis.

muted.$description: The translucent warning tint of badges and alerts: a clean light amber rather than the warning text color, which would turn a light surface tan.

$root.$description: Controls in the warning tone without a fill at rest, such as an alert’s dismiss button: transparent, as color.bg.neutral.subtle is.

hover.$description: The stronger warning tint, which fills a warning alert and a soft badge and lies under a control without a fill in the warning tone, such as a warning alert’s dismiss button, under the pointer: a light amber at 36% in light, at either contrast, so a light surface takes a clean amber rather than tan; the warning text color at 17% in dark, and 14% at high contrast.

pressed.$description: The warning state layer while pressed: the light amber at 50% in light, at either contrast; the warning text color at 25% in dark, and 22% at high contrast.

emphasis.$description: A solid danger fill; paired with fg.on-emphasis.

muted.$description: The translucent danger tint of badges and alerts.

$root.$description: Controls in the danger tone without a fill at rest, such as an alert’s dismiss button: transparent, as color.bg.neutral.subtle is.

hover.$description: The state layer of a control without a fill in the danger tone, such as an error alert’s dismiss button, under the pointer: the danger text color at 14%, in every theme and at high contrast.

pressed.$description: The danger state layer while pressed: the danger text color at 22%.

$root.$description: The danger fill of destructive actions and error toasts in both themes; paired with fg.on-strong.

hover.$description: A destructive action under the pointer: lighter, as in 0.7, at the lightest grade that keeps white labels at 4.5:1.

pressed.$description: A destructive action while pressed. It can’t lighten further without its white label falling below 4.5:1, so it settles halfway back.

emphasis.$description: A solid done fill; paired with fg.on-emphasis.

muted.$description: The translucent done tint of badges.

$root.$description: The information fill of toasts in both themes; paired with fg.on-strong.

hover.$description: A control on the information toast under the pointer. Its white label keeps 4.5:1.

pressed.$description: A control on the information toast while pressed. Its white label keeps 4.5:1.

$root.$description: The accent purple of accent actions, such as Button's accent tone, in both themes; paired with fg.on-strong.

hover.$description: An accent action under the pointer.

pressed.$description: An accent action while pressed.

$root.$description: Controls in the accent tone without a fill at rest: transparent, as color.bg.neutral.subtle is.

hover.$description: The state layer of a control without a fill in the accent tone under the pointer, and the tonal fill of an accent badge: the accent text color at 14%.

pressed.$description: The accent state layer while pressed: the accent text color at 22%.

muted.$description: The translucent accent tint of soft accent badges in dark and at high contrast; in light they take color.bg.accent.soft.

soft.$description: The tint of a soft accent badge: in light the accent purple at 5%, so the purple text keeps 4.5:1 over it; in dark and at high contrast it is color.bg.accent.muted.

solid.$description: A solid accent fill, such as a solid accent badge; paired with fg.on-emphasis.

inset.$description: The page color at half strength, which leans a pill on a button’s fill back toward the page instead of adding another fill, as a diff stat in a tab does.

$root.$description: The fill of a list item: the muted surface in both themes and at high contrast, so items stand apart from the page and from a surface.

hover.$description: A list item under the pointer.

pressed.$description: A list item while pressed.

$root.$description: The default fill, the powder hue: the fill of an avatar whose hue nothing sets.

powder.$description: The powder blue pastel fill, one of the hues an avatar takes from its name.

seafoam.$description: The seafoam pastel fill, one of the hues an avatar takes from its name.

sage.$description: The sage pastel fill, one of the hues an avatar takes from its name.

butter.$description: The butter yellow pastel fill, one of the hues an avatar takes from its name.

blush.$description: The blush pink pastel fill, one of the hues an avatar takes from its name.

periwinkle.$description: The periwinkle pastel fill, one of the hues an avatar takes from its name.

orchid.$description: The orchid pastel fill, one of the hues an avatar takes from its name.

oat.$description: The warm oat pastel fill, one of the hues an avatar takes from its name.

default.$description: Body text and the labels of rows, fields and choice controls.

$root.$description: Supporting text, icons, field labels, descriptions and placeholders, row details, unchecked checkbox rings: every former synonym (muted, quiet, icon, field label, hint, placeholder, row detail).

hover.$description: Muted text that responds to the pointer, such as a Disclosure summary, gains contrast.

pressed.$description: Muted text while pressed.

control.$description: The labels of navigation items, secondary buttons and Select options, the values of meters and sliders, and the thumb of a switch that is off.

$root.$description: Links and text buttons: at least 4.5:1 on every surface and row.

hover.$description: A link under the pointer.

pressed.$description: A link while pressed.

primary.$description: Primary text and icons: the primary tone, outlined button labels, the selected tab, a field's focused label, the icon of a pager link.

accent.$description: Accent text and icons: the purple of an accent badge.

on-selected.$description: Text and indicators on bg.selected and its states.

danger.$description: Danger text and icons, and field errors.

on-emphasis.$description: Text and icons on the emphasis fills: white in light, dark in dark.

on-strong.$description: White in both themes, on the strong fills: labels at 4.5:1 on the danger, accent, neutral, success and information fills, at rest, hovered and pressed; marks at 3:1 on the primary strong fill.

$root.$description: Links and text buttons on a tint, where fg.link falls below 4.5:1: inside alerts, on bg.primary.muted, and in list rows and interactive table rows under the pointer or pressed. In light it is a grade darker than fg.link and darkens on hover and press; in dark it is fg.link at rest and lightens on hover and press, where fg.link darkens. Alerts and those rows point fg.link at it; an application puts it on bg.brand-muted.

hover.$description: A link on a tint under the pointer.

pressed.$description: A link on a tint while pressed.

avatar-figure.$description: The default figure of an avatar without an image, the same deep shade as its initials, at least 3:1 on its fill.

$root.$description: The default figure, on the powder fill.

powder.$description: The default figure on the powder fill, the shade of its initials.

seafoam.$description: The default figure on the seafoam fill, the shade of its initials.

sage.$description: The default figure on the sage fill, the shade of its initials.

butter.$description: The default figure on the butter fill, the shade of its initials.

blush.$description: The default figure on the blush fill, the shade of its initials.

periwinkle.$description: The default figure on the periwinkle fill, the shade of its initials.

orchid.$description: The default figure on the orchid fill, the shade of its initials.

oat.$description: The default figure on the oat fill, the shade of its initials.

rating-star.$description: The filled stars and the filled half of a half star: a clear gold.

avatar.$description: The initials of an avatar, in a deep shade of its fill's hue: at least 4.5:1 on its fill, and 7:1 at high contrast.

$root.$description: The default initials, on the powder fill.

powder.$description: The initials on the powder fill.

seafoam.$description: The initials on the seafoam fill.

sage.$description: The initials on the sage fill.

butter.$description: The initials on the butter fill.

blush.$description: The initials on the blush fill.

periwinkle.$description: The initials on the periwinkle fill.

orchid.$description: The initials on the orchid fill.

oat.$description: The initials on the oat fill.

$root.$description: The boundary of a control that has no other edge: outlined fields and buttons, the track of a switch that is off. At least 3:1 on every surface.

hover.$description: A control boundary under the pointer.

pressed.$description: A control boundary while pressed.

$root.$description: The hairlines between the items of one list, across its full width: table rows, Markdown rules, menu separators and accordion items; and decorative edges that are not a control’s only boundary: quote bars, keyboard keys and color swatches. Regions separate by space and background instead. A floating layer takes its own, clearer edge, elevation.{level}.border.

hover.$description: A decorative outline under the pointer, such as a resize handle or a pager link.

pressed.$description: A decorative outline while pressed.

$root.$description: A decorative edge in the primary tone, around an outlined primary badge: the primary text color at 55%, in every theme and at high contrast.

muted.$description: The faint edge of an info alert: the primary text color at 28%, in every theme and at high contrast.

$root.$description: The active border and label of a focused field, and today’s ring in a calendar.

hover.$description: An active field border under the pointer.

pressed.$description: An active field border while pressed.

accent.$description: A decorative edge in the accent tone, around an outlined accent badge: the accent text color at 55%.

$root.$description: A decorative edge in the danger tone, around an outlined badge and a message that failed to send: the danger text color at 55%, in every theme and at high contrast.

muted.$description: The faint edge of an error alert: the danger text color at 28%, in every theme and at high contrast.

strong.$description: The edge of the strong danger fill where it floats, on error toasts. In light the fill is dark on a light page, so its edge is the fill a step darker, about 1.3:1 from it: it reads as the fill’s own edge rather than a light halo, and still sets the fill apart from a surface of its color. High contrast keeps that step, from the darker high-contrast fill, far above 4.5:1 on the page. In dark, where the fill is lighter than the page as every popup is, it is the popup edge, elevation.2.border, and color.border.default at high contrast. A dark edge, unlike the 0.7 alias color.border-strong, which is the light divider color, border.muted.

$root.$description: The border of an invalid field.

hover.$description: An invalid field border under the pointer.

pressed.$description: An invalid field border while pressed.

$root.$description: A decorative edge in the neutral tone, around an outlined badge: the muted text color at 55%, in every theme and at high contrast.

strong.$description: The edge of the strong neutral fill where it floats, on tooltips and neutral toasts. In light the fill is dark on a light page, so its edge is the fill a step darker, about 1.3:1 from it: it reads as the fill’s own edge rather than a light halo, and still sets the fill apart from a surface of its color. High contrast keeps that step, from the darker high-contrast fill, far above 4.5:1 on the page. In dark, where the fill is lighter than the page as every popup is, it is the popup edge, elevation.2.border, and color.border.default at high contrast. A dark edge, unlike the 0.7 alias color.border-strong, which is the light divider color, border.muted.

$root.$description: A decorative edge in the success tone, around an outlined badge: the success text color at 55%, in every theme and at high contrast.

muted.$description: The faint edge of a success alert: the success text color at 28%, in every theme and at high contrast.

strong.$description: The edge of the strong success fill where it floats, on success toasts. In light the fill is dark on a light page, so its edge is the fill a step darker, about 1.3:1 from it: it reads as the fill’s own edge rather than a light halo, and still sets the fill apart from a surface of its color. High contrast keeps that step, from the darker high-contrast fill, far above 4.5:1 on the page. In dark, where the fill is lighter than the page as every popup is, it is the popup edge, elevation.2.border, and color.border.default at high contrast. A dark edge, unlike the 0.7 alias color.border-strong, which is the light divider color, border.muted.

$root.$description: A decorative edge in the warning tone, around an outlined badge: the warning text color at 55%, in every theme and at high contrast.

muted.$description: The faint edge of a warning alert: the warning text color at 28%, in every theme and at high contrast.

focus.$description: Focus rings: at least 3:1 against what they are drawn on.

strong.$description: The edge of the strong information fill where it floats, on information toasts. In light the fill is dark on a light page, so its edge is the fill a step darker, about 1.3:1 from it: it reads as the fill’s own edge rather than a light halo, and still sets the fill apart from a surface of its color. High contrast keeps that step, from the darker high-contrast fill, far above 4.5:1 on the page. In dark, where the fill is lighter than the page as every popup is, it is the popup edge, elevation.2.border, and color.border.default at high contrast. A dark edge, unlike the 0.7 alias color.border-strong, which is the light divider color, border.muted.

done.$description: A decorative edge in the done tone, around an outlined badge: the done text color at 55%, in every theme and at high contrast.

media.$description: A neutral inner edge that defines content of any color, such as the color picker’s area: black at 5% in both themes.
